gray.$description: Cool neutral ramp, authored in OKLCH (ENGINE §2.3: CSS consumes oklch() as-is, print gets a build-time sRGB conversion). Hue 250 keeps the neutrals off the warm cream band that reads as a default.

persimmon.$description: The single accent. One hue per brand is the discipline — a second accent is a second brand argument.

200.$description: the accent at wash strength. Chroma is deliberately kept up: a pale warm tint below ~0.06 lands in the cream band gate 0b bans, and reads as beige rather than as the accent.
